package.description: RetroShare is a decentralized, private, secure, cross-platform, communication toolkit.

en-US.description: RetroShare is a decentralized, private, secure, cross-platform, communication toolkit.
en-US.longDescription:
Retroshare establishes encrypted connections between you and your friends to create a network of computers, and provides various distributed services on top of it.
Retroshare is fully decentralized, and designed to provide maximum security and anonymity to its users beyond direct friends.
en-US.name: RetroShare
